title: Streaming compliance events API and signed webhook delivery for residency/retention evidence
creator: Marcus Li
description:
Goal: Provide a robust streaming Compliance Events API plus enterprise-grade webhook delivery to automate audit evidence for data residency, retention enforcement, and retention reporting. This ticket scopes the event model, delivery guarantees, signing/key rotation, tenant scoping, and minimal operational UI for customers to register endpoints and inspect delivery history. The design must work for Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployment modes and support high-volume customers without impacting runtime SLOs.

Scope in this ticket:
- Define event schema v1 for the core event types: residency_change, retention_policy_applied, retention_grace_exhausted, record_purged, audit_log_entry_snapshot, evidence_export_ready.
- Implement a streaming endpoint (/v1/compliance/events) that supports both long-polling and HTTP POST webhook fanout.
- Build webhook registration API (/v1/compliance/webhooks) with per-tenant configuration: allowed event types, residency_region filter, retention_age filter, and delivery retry policy.
- Add HMAC signing header (XRW-Signature) with rotating signing keys and documented verification steps.
- Ensure at-least-once delivery semantics with deduplication guidance (event_id + event_ts) and idempotency window.
- Implement backpressure controls and burst buffering to avoid runtime latency impact; provide metrics for dropped vs queued events.
- Add an evidence-reporting mode that stores signed delivery receipts and proof bundles (manifest + signed event hashes) for customers that require SOC2/ISO evidence exports.

Non-goals: Full UI for webhook analytics (only basic delivery log view), deep SIEM integrations (customers will pull via webhook or S3 delivery), migration path for legacy audit webhooks (will be a separate migration ticket).
comments: 2026-02-26 - Aisha: Spike complete. Verified we can stream events from the runtime telemetry pipeline with <2ms overhead for non-batched paths. Prototype uses Kafka topic compliance.events, consumer produces HTTP fanout.
2026-03-03 - Marcus: Design review with PM & Security. Security asked for key rotation plan and support for mutual TLS for Private instances. Added 'mTLS optional' to requirements for Private/VPC.

2026-03-05 - Aisha: Implemented initial webhook registration endpoints and stored configs in tenant metadata store. Running local integ tests for filtering by residency_region. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/10421

2026-03-09 - Security review note from Priya: Must include replay window and nonce for signature verification to mitigate replay attacks. Also require an audit flag for evidence exports that cannot be deleted for retention_duration + evidence_hold_time.
2026-03-12 - QA: Found intermittent duplicate deliveries when consumer restarts. Added dedupe token generation and checkpointing to consumer; working on e2e tests.
2026-03-14 - PM (Evan): Requested acceptance criteria include sample payloads + OpenAPI spec before merging. Also asked to expose delivery metrics to Console under Compliance > Webhooks.
acceptance_criteria: OpenAPI spec published for /v1/compliance/events and /v1/compliance/webhooks (v1 schema) with example payloads for each event type
Webhook registration API implemented and validated end-to-end in staging (create/update/delete, filters, retry settings)
Signed webhook delivery with XRW-Signature header and documented verification flow; key-rotation endpoint available for customers
At-least-once delivery with documented deduplication strategy; e2e tests prove dedupe within 72-hour idempotency window
Evidence export mode stores signed receipts + manifest in tenant-bucket (Hosted) or tenant-specified S3 location (Dedicated/Private) and is retrievable via API
Basic delivery history UI surfaces failed/queued/succeeded counts and shows last 7 days of attempts in Console
Security review checklist items closed: replay protection, nonce/timestamp validation, mTLS support for Private, immutable evidence retention flag implemented
